newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar pares gains by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar pares gains by close.

text.p: White sugar futures crept pared Tuesday's modest gains by the close in routine trading with the widening August/October spread about the only feature of interest.
Traders said the London market was taking some of its firmer sentiment from New York, where attention was concentrated on the forthcoming May expiry.
At the close August was up $0.80 at $311.00 after an intraday high of $311.50. October was up $0.50 at $305.20 after the front two months traded 1,035 and 380 lots respectively.
Light commission house buying of the August/October white sugar spread was the main feature in London as the nearby differential widened out to $5.80 after $4.50 at the end of last week
"That's fairly steady at the moment...but it's all fairly routine stuff," said one trader.
In physical news, most traders were pondering the likely tonnage and origins of deliveries against May raws and the recent Russian purchases.
Russia is thought to have bought a substantial amount of Cuban raw sugar over the past few days, mainly through the Black Sea port of Novorossisk but also through Riga.
Trading was quiet in Paris where August was up 20 cents at $311.00 and October down 30 cents at $305.00.
